l3_title: Delete Parent Or Change Input Policy
goal: behaviour for missing inputs and changed output topology
positive_oracle: parent curve deleted; a child uses its semantic rail reference -> child marked broken; the report offers KeepBroken/DetachDependents/RemoveDependents and the chosen policy leaves no dangling reference
negative_oracle: delete the parent while a child is rebuilding asynchronously -> Error::Busy and the document is unchanged
checkout: QymCAD/ (vendored subtree of the main repository; no independent .git)
method: bounded file reads with line numbers; decisions are OM9-owned and no upstream code is copied

observed_symbols: delete feature together with its body, clear the caches and rebuild
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: the cascade is mechanical and has no user policy; OM9 reports the broken children and lets the caller choose repair/removal

observed_symbols: a node with nothing to rebuild from is counted as changed, marked, and a rebuild of nothing is started
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: nothing names the missing input; OM9 keeps Unresolved('source missing') and lists it in the report

observed_symbols: a rebuild starts only when no job is in hand, so no job is dropped while the window works
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: the exclusion is job-level; OM9 states it per feature with RebuildActivity and refuses the delete with Error::Busy

implemented_api: crates/om9-core/src/associative.rs: BrokenInputPolicy, BrokenDependency, DeleteSourceReport, RebuildActivity, delete_source_input, drop_references_of
reuse_decision: ADAPT the rebuild/dirty/persistent-id ideas; ADD the typed durable ports, the persisted semantic reference and the content baselines.
